_help: Demo content for the fictional Wayfarer brand (portfolio project). People, quotes and ratings are invented. Swap in real, consented entries before any real use; mark placeholders with "sample": true and the production build will refuse to ship them. For a real branch, copy the rating, review count and reviews link from its Google Business Profile.
